newsitem.title: USA: AST Research credit extended, increased.
newsitem.headline: AST Research credit extended, increased.

text.p: AST Research Inc said Monday it had received a one-year extension of a previous $200 million bank credit guarantee agreement provided by Samsung Electronics Co Ltd, to December 31, 1998.
The company also said it had finalized a new $200 million, two-year bank credit guarantee agreement with Samsung.

Samsung is providing guarantees for a total of $300 million in bank credit for AST, effective December 13, rising to $400 million on April 1, 1997, and continuing at that level through the end of 1998, the company said.
In consideration for the support agreement, AST said it has granted Samsung 500,000 shares of non-voting preferred stock.
The stock is redeemable beginning in 1999 for about 13 shares of AST common stock, or $100.75 cash.

Samsung already owns about 46 percent of AST common stock, with a five-year option to purchase up to 4.4 million shares at $0.01 per share. If the option is exercised in full, Samsung would would own about 49.6 percent of AST, the computer company said.
